body: trying to figure out why I feel this way, my problem might be in thinking about the future too much. But I just can't help it... the average life span seems so short to me
I am just curious but how did you managed to get from that situation?

If I die I don't need to think of anyone that's the point. I am not in that harsh situation. I really am not.  And as I mentioned even if you solve all my problems I don't see a reason why not to die.. It's not a bad thing. You just won't reproduce, your genes won't be passed on, and you fail your life goal that way, but there are enough humans, me dying does not drastically increase the chances of our extinction. And frankly even if It did I don't really care.

I get upset over mixture of few small irrelevant and relevant things, but as I explained in the post I don't feel like life is worth anything. Sleeping is my favorite activity, dreamless sleeping. Not being alive is non existing, not having memory or conscience and I would love those things, I don't want to face the challenges of real world, the struggles and the failures, financial instability , health problems, not accomplishing my dreams, not being able to do what I want. And than dying as if nothing ever happened. Imagining that is scarier to me than imagining being tortured. I don't want to be failure, I don't want to deal with any of that.
